facts.fact: Under the Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY), assistive devices are given free to eligible senior citizens
facts.quote: Launched in 2017 to provide free assistive devices to eligible BPL senior citizens or those with monthly income below ₹15,000.

facts.fact: Devices given include walking sticks, crutches, walkers, hearing aids, wheelchairs, artificial dentures and spectacles
facts.quote: Some of the assisted living devices provided are Walking Sticks, Elbow Crutches, Walkers/ Crutches, Tripods/ Quadpods,Hearing Aids, Wheelchairs, Artificial Dentures, Spectacles, etc.

facts.fact: Eligible: senior citizens with age-related disability or infirmity and a monthly income of not more than Rs 15,000 (BPL senior citizens are covered)
facts.quote: senior citizens with a monthly income of not more than ₹15,000 and suffering from age-related disabilities or infirmities are provided physical aids and assisted-living devices
facts.note: Wording differs slightly between official pages: dosje.gov.in RVY page says 'Senior citizens belonging to the BPL category and with monthly income not more than Rs. 15000/-'; PIB Year-End Review 2025 says 'BPL senior citizens or those with monthly income below ₹15,000'. The 13 Aug 2026 PIB release is the newest.

facts.fact: Devices are distributed in camps: beneficiaries are identified in assessment camps held with the State Government / District Administration
facts.quote: These devices are distributed in the camp mode. The beneficiaries are identified through Assessment Camps organised in collaboration with the respective State Government/District Administration.

behaviour: Explains Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana: which aids are given free, who is eligible and how they are given (assessment camps), with citation to the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment / PIB. Replies in Hindi.
fail_if: Says every senior citizen gets the aids regardless of income, invents a cash benefit, or gives eligibility criteria not on the official pages.
summary: RVY (DoSJE/PIB): free aids such as spectacles, walking sticks, hearing aids for seniors with income up to Rs 15,000/month (BPL), distributed through assessment camps.
